name: dingtalk-mcp
description: DingTalk (钉钉) (messaging): send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_dingtalk_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DINGTALK_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_dingtalk_app_key.description: Client ID (formerly AppKey) of the internal enterprise app that owns the robot; exchanged at POST https://api.dingtalk.com/v1.0/oauth2/accessToken for a 7200-second accessToken.

platform_mcp_dingtalk_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DINGTALK_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_dingtalk_app_secret.description: Client Secret (formerly AppSecret) of the same app (developer console, 凭证与基础信息).

platform_mcp_dingtalk_robot_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DINGTALK_ROBOT_CODE
platform_mcp_dingtalk_robot_code.description: robotCode of the internal-app robot (developer console robot page; usually equals the app key).

tools.name: send
tools.description: One-to-one robot message (msgKey sampleText, msgParam serialized {"content": …}) to the user whose userId is `to`; message_id is processQueryKey (for the read-status and recall APIs). Users the robot may not reach come back in raw.invalidStaffIdList / flowControlledStaffIdList. `subject`/`channel` are ignored.
